basic_details.job_title: AAI Sr Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 23 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Only serving departmental Group 'C' and 'D' employees of the Airports Authority of India (AAI), Eastern Region, can apply for these 23 Sr Assistant (Operational) (NE-6) vacancies (SC 3, ST 01, UR 19), which will be filled through a Departmental Examination. The post carries a pay scale of Rs. 36,000 - 1,10,000/- and requires graduation with an LMV licence and 02 years of relevant experience. Applications in the enclosed proforma go "Through Proper Channel" and are forwarded by email to [email protected] on or before 30 November 2026, followed by hard copies through speed post.

how_to_apply: Fill in the enclosed proforma, "Application for the post of Sr Assistant (Ops) (NE-6), Departmental Examination - 2026". It asks for your full name in block letters as per the Service Book, father's name, designation, employee number, date of birth, community (ST/UR), date of appointment in CAD/NAA/IAAI/AAI, present scale of pay and basic pay, educational and other qualifications, date of joining or promotion in the present grade, present station of posting, experience in the relevant field, and willingness to transfer to any station under ER.
Sign the Declaration and Undertaking stating that the information you have furnished is true and correct.
Submit the application "Through Proper Channel" at your airport or station.

The HOD HR of the establishment or station verifies all particulars in the proforma (date of birth, caste, educational qualifications and so on) from your service record. The HOD HR then signs the certificate with name, designation and office seal, confirming that no disciplinary or vigilance case is pending or contemplated against you.
The application, with self-attested copies of the documents listed below, is forwarded by email to [email protected] positively on or before 30 November 2026.
Hard copies then follow by speed post to: General Manager (HR)ER, AAI, RHQ, ER, NSCBI Airport, Kolkata - 700052.
Self-attested copies of academic and professional qualification certificates
Self-attested caste certificate. The proforma asks for a copy for ST candidates.
Documents supporting experience in the relevant field, such as an office order or an experience certificate issued by the APDs, the Officer in charge or the HoD of the concerned station or department
PAR grading for the preceding 5 years up to 2025-2026
Certificate from the HOD HR that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date, or otherwise found incomplete, will not be entertained. AAI reserves the right to modify, alter, restrict or cancel the recruitment process if the need arises, without any further notice and without assigning any reasons. The decision of the Competent Authority will be final, and no appeal will be entertained in this regard. The Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Kolkata. In case of any dispute, the English version will be valid. The circular has been sent to RED NR/WR/SR/NER/CATC and APD Kolkata/Chennai, so that they can bring it to the notice of Group C and D employees working at their regions or stations whose seniority is maintained at RHQ, ER. For enquiries, the RHQ Eastern Region office at N.S.C.B.I. Airport, Kolkata can be reached on Phone (033) 25119600 or Fax (033) 25110360.

content_sections.heading: About AAI Sr Assistant (Operational) (NE-6)
content_sections.text: The circular is issued by the Office of the Regional Executive Director, Airports Authority of India, Eastern Region, located at N.S.C.B.I. Airport, Kolkata - 700052. It is addressed to the Airport Directors at Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Bagdogra, Cooch Behar, Deoghar, Darbhanga, Gaya, Jharsuguda, Pakyong, Patna, Port Blair, Raipur and Ranchi, and to the Officers-In-Charge at Katihar, Behala, Berhampur, Durgapur and Jamshedpur. The vacancies are being filled under Clause 22 (v) (b) of the Notified AAI (R&P) Regulations, 2020 dated 16.01.2020 and its subsequent amendments and circulars.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The 23 vacancies in the grade of Sr Assistant (Operational) (NE-6) are divided by category as follows. The Competent Authority reserves the right to increase or decrease the vacancies depending upon future requirements.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible and willing departmental candidates from the Eastern Region who possess the requisite qualifications and experience under the R&P Regulations, 2020 and the subsequent circulars and amendments. The eligible group is departmental Group 'C' and 'D' employees from all disciplines. Experience: 02 years relevant experience in the concerned discipline. Experience of Fire Service will be considered as relevant experience. Age limit: The upper age limit is 50 years as on 30/11/2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Cut-off for qualification and experience: Eligibility with respect to educational qualification and experience will be reckoned as on 30/11/2026. Willingness to serve: Applications are invited from interested eligible departmental employees who are willing to serve at various airports under the Eastern Region. The proforma also asks whether the applicant is willing to transfer to any station under ER, if selected. The full eligibility conditions are those of the AAI (R&P) Regulations, 2020 as cited in the official notification.

content_sections.text: The pay scale of the Sr Assistant (Operational) (NE-6) grade is Rs. 36,000 - 1,10,000/-. The circular does not list any allowances, and it does not mention the in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The 23 vacancies will be filled through a Departmental Examination for the Eastern Region. Only applications of eligible departmental candidates that the concerned Airport, Station or RHQ forwards through proper channel within the stipulated time will be considered for the further selection process. The examination date, the exam pattern and the syllabus are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there for AAI Sr Assistant (Operational) (NE-6) in the Eastern Region?
faq.answer: There are 23 vacancies: SC 3, ST 01 and UR 19. The Competent Authority may increase or decrease them depending upon future requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded by email to [email protected] positively on or before 30 November 2026. Hard copies then follow by speed post.

faq.question: Q3. Can outside candidates apply for this AAI recruitment?
faq.answer: No. Only departmental Group 'C' and 'D' employees from all disciplines in the AAI Eastern Region are eligible, and they must apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: You must be a graduate with an LMV licence and have 02 years of relevant experience in the concerned discipline. A Dip. in Management will be preferred.

faq.question: Q5. Does Fire Service experience count?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states that experience of Fire Service will be considered as relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for AAI Sr Assistant (Operational) (NE-6)?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years as on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay scale for Sr Assistant (Operational) (NE-6)?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs. 36,000 - 1,10,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the AAI Sr Assistant (Operational) departmental exam?
faq.answer: Fill in the enclosed proforma and submit it through proper channel. The HOD HR verifies and certifies it, and the application is then emailed to [email protected] by 30 November 2026. Hard copies follow by speed post to the General Manager (HR)ER, AAI, RHQ, ER, NSCBI Airport, Kolkata - 700052.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The vacancies will be filled through a Departmental Examination. Only applications forwarded through proper channel within the stipulated time will be considered.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Send self-attested copies of your qualification and caste certificates, your experience documents, and your PAR grading for the preceding 5 years up to 2025-2026. Also include the HOD HR certificate stating that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending.
